reason: The cited evidence (E1) only discusses oxygen contamination in as-cast/heat-treated Nb-containing bcc solid solutions and their stability, without mentioning aluminization, alumina scale formation, or any protective coating. None of the key premises about the intervention or its mechanism are supported by this passage.
premises: Aluminization enriches the surface of refractory HEAs with Al.
Al-enriched surface forms a continuous, protective Al2O3 scale in air at 800°C.
Al2O3 scale limits oxygen ingress into the underlying alloy.
Reduced oxygen ingress prevents formation of oxygen-contaminated Nb-based phases.
Prevention of contamination retains mechanical properties (hardness, Young's modulus).
